title: On Preferring the longer shady road
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：prefer　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prefer 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the grandmother ① preferred the longer shady road in silence, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grandmother ② prefers the longer shady road twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ prefer the longer shady road at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ preferred the longer shady road before — a line in the diary for February 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Preferring the longer shady road in silence, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ prefer a charge against the clerk twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Prefer a charge against the clerk at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the diary, and a new child from the next courtyard ⑧ prefers a charge against the clerk in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the window, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ preferred the longer shady road again when nobody else would.

⑩ To prefer the longer shady road, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the courtyard remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the courtyard forgets, somebody prefers the longer shady road twice over again and somebody must prefer the longer shady road in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 更喜欢（一般过去式 preferred the longer shady road：1950 年祖母头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 更喜欢（一般现在 prefers the longer shady road：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 更喜欢（不定式 to prefer the longer shady road：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 更喜欢（过去完成时 had preferred the longer shady road：1944 年二月的日记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 更喜欢（动名词 preferring the longer shady road 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 提出（prefer a charge against the clerk：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去提出对那位办事员提出一项指控）
G. v. 提出（prefer a charge against the clerk：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 更喜欢（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 prefers a charge against the clerk，而母亲又一次 preferred the longer shady road）

answers.why: prefer 意为“更喜欢”，1950 年祖母一言不发地更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路，那是院子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 preferred。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，自那以后祖母来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 prefers。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路”，此处为不定式 to prefer the longer shady road。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，日记里 二月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人更喜欢过，故用过去完成时 had preferred。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，祖母说“更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 preferring the longer shady road 作主语。
prefer 意为“提出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去提出对那位办事员提出一项指控”，should ever 之后用原形 prefer a charge against the clerk。
prefer 意为“提出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻提出对那位办事员提出一项指控（prefer a charge against the clerk at once），以后再也不要提起。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，新来的孩子每个年头都照例提出对那位办事员提出一项指控，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 prefers。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路，用一般过去式 preferred 叙述。
prefer 意为“更喜欢”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和院子记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，祖母一言不发地更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路；院子里每一个孩子都说这是头一回。（preferred the longer shady road）
多年以后，祖母仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（prefers the longer shady road）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路这件事本身。（to prefer the longer shady road）
早在 1944 年就有人更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路，二月那天日记上的一行字就是证据。（had preferred the longer shady road）
祖母说过，一言不发地更喜欢更愿意走那条有荫的远路这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（preferring the longer shady road 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻提出对那位办事员提出一项指控，以后再也不要提起。（prefer a charge against the clerk，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 prefer 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the grandmother preferred the longer shady road in silence, and nobody in the courtyard forgot it.
Even now the grandmother prefers the longer shady road twice over whenever the courtyard asks.
Preferring the longer shady road in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever prefer a charge against the clerk twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next courtyard prefers a charge against the clerk in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother preferred the longer shady road again, and the courtyard remembered that half.
